author: reek
body: Active dungeon run gameplay. This is the Diablo layer - the actual floor-by-floor, encounter-by-encounter resolution of a player moving through a dungeon. Combat turns, loot drops, trap detection, floor advancement, boss fights, death and recovery.

author: reek
body: The run is deterministic given a seed - the same seed produces the same encounter sequence, loot rolls, and trap placements. This makes runs replayable and verifiable on-chain.
